notes: The audit found further duplicate Host operations: weather, day_time and world_height are available on both sides, while their LevelRef counterparts are server-only. Removing them as requested would remove client functionality; the issue does not specify the client-side handle contracts for these additional operations. The existing client LevelRef read path covers blocks, but not these world properties. No PR was opened and no changes were retained. The sample already uses LevelRef::block. The wasm check was stopped while waiting for the shared build lock; no checks passed are claimed.
